text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Is this for me...? You remembered my 
birthday! Thank you, Desire-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all. Blessing others is a 
saint's most important duty, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is a holy stone infused with my 
sacred prayers— it should bestow upon you 
the blessing of good health.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A prayer... So it's a charm filled with 
your feelings, Desire-chan! Fufu, that 
makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's truly a beautiful, wonderful 
red... Just looking at it makes my heart 
sparkle—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, somehow... doesn't it kind of look 
like Desire-chan?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! N-No way... Did you just sense the 
"color" of the power I poured into that—?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You truly are worthy of being the 
trial that a saint must overcome...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
When the power imbued within the sacred 
stone begins to fade, please do not 
hesitate to bring it back to me. I shall 
bestow a fresh holy blessing upon it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Does that mean I can go ask 
Desire-chan whenever it's time for 
maintenance...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Along with this little one, I'll 
bring some snacks and tea to come play...!
